notes.review: Certified 2026-11-16 against tree 2e19f41: every acceptance criterion passes from the CLI entry point (tests/detector_false_positives.rs, regression seeds, unit tests); Clippy clean on 1.99.1; documentation gates green; Windows gate green in a CRLF replay worktree (34 failures, all in the ledger). Linux gates moved to US-035 by Arthur's decision of 2026-11-16 (PRD 1.1); a partial WSL run passed the lib, the bin and every integration binary through rule_scaling_surfaces, apart from wall-clock budgets that also sit at their bound at HEAD. DoD seed clause read as covering the three rules whose fix silences a finding: secret_in_build_step (Info demotion) and oversized_unit (context change) are proven by fixture tests the seed harness cannot express.

The failures are not EP-004's: the packed smoke ('human progress is not the phase lines') and launcher-packed 'exit 0' (duration normalizer) also fail alone on the parent c64eaa8 (tree fb6541f9), both from EP-003's US-013 and US-012 wording, fixed on HEAD by US-037; tmux-helpers 'the byte log holds every byte' failed once, passed on ci-run-files.sh's retry and alone (11 passed). known-bugs, cli-surface and output-streams pass alone on the tree (71 passed). notes.review: Certified 2026-11-16 against tree 0d4c296 (the epic's uncommitted work on 09adad8): every acceptance criterion passes from the CLI or library entry point; Clippy clean on 1.99.1; documentation gates green; Windows gate green in a CRLF replay worktree (34 failures, all in the ledger); lambda_freeze.rs unchanged and green. Linux gates and the cross-platform float check move to US-036 (PRD 1.1). The ignored harness (cargo test --lib calibration -- --ignored) reproduces docs/core-v7-calibration-2026-11.md on Windows. The audited-workspace figures come from a rescan (1448 findings, 186759 lines, same score 36, same 23 rules) rather than the 1438 the audit published, since the audit carries no site-level facts; the record says so.
notes.linux: 2026-11-17, Fedora 45, scripts/linux-ci-replay.sh on 9aef6c7 (the commit that lands EP-005), tree 11e5c6a329109abcaf4213c053afd9cbac74b249, rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13): clippy, docs, msrv, launcher (19), release pass; test 1359 passed, 5 failed, 6 ignored; packed fails; e2e 1424 passed, 26 failed (13 distinct), 20 skipped. audit_contract (12), score_credibility_kernel (7) and the lib unit tests (681, src/audit/tests.rs included) pass with the exact scores they assert on Windows, so 1 + ln(n) rounds alike on both platforms; lambda_freeze.rs is unchanged since 7991b7a and its 3 tests pass; the US-023 harness (cargo test --lib calibration -- --ignored) reproduces docs/core-v7-calibration-2026-11.md on the LF checkout. The parent ed2a9be differs from 7f6f4d9 in tasks/ only, and 7f6f4d9's replay passes all 18 failing tests, so EP-005 caused them: the 4 cargo tests and 12 e2e tests that assert a warning or a weighing for clippy::unwrap_used or clippy::mem_forget, which US-027 publishes at Info (delta_correspondence, rule_scaling_surfaces, score_credibility_packs x2, EX-02 to EX-04, OW-02 to OW-04, OC-10, EN-04 x3, EN-08, INV-08), CF-32, which still assumed either threshold reports (US-027), and agent_loop's lockfile scope test, a product regression of US-028 (BUG-25). The packed smoke fails on EP-003 text, pre-existing since c64eaa8.
